name: CAG-GS Semantic Mapping and Gaussian Generation
definition: A method that generates implicit 3D Gaussians from semantic anchors using a multi-resolution hash grid to encode spatial position into high-dimensional semantic vectors, which are then fused with anchor features to predict Gaussian attributes.
summary: CAG-GS generates implicit 3D Gaussians from semantic anchors using a multi-resolution hash grid, distinguishing itself by incorporating semantic guidance and geometric consistency constraints to improve global consistency in large-scale scenes.
